READ THE FINE PRINT

Useful data.
Honest boundaries.

This is an independent analysis of publicly accessible Devpost pages. It is not affiliated with Meta or Devpost and does not predict judging results.

Download source dataset
Coverage & snapshot

The gallery and individual pages may be cached differently by Devpost. Counts can change during collection. Duplicate gallery entries are removed by project ID. This is a saved snapshot, not a live feed. Recollection requires rerunning the supplied collector and redeploying.

Categories, new apps & submission dates

Selected submission categories, the new/existing app answer, and exact submission timestamps are not exposed on the public pages inspected. Official category and submittedAt remain null in the dataset.

Category estimates use explicit keyword matches in titles and taglines. The largest keyword count wins; ties and zero matches are unclassified. First public activity comes from the “started this project” update; record creation comes from dateCreated metadata. Neither is a submission timestamp. App-history mentions are narrative clues, not organizer-verified eligibility.

Images, trailers & trials

Cover image means a custom gallery thumbnail rather than Devpost’s default placeholder; it does not certify a separate hero asset. Video means a public embedded video in the project carousel, which may be a demo rather than a polished trailer. Screenshots count uploaded carousel images.

Trial/demo evidence is a matching phrase in a project story. We do not establish price, free trials in stores, availability, or whether links work. “Not established” is never treated as “no.” Store/distribution links include Meta, Steam, and itch.io links listed in “Try it out.”

Previous wins & engagement

Previous-win evidence is limited to visible award indicators on public Devpost pages. Lack of an indicator does not prove someone has never won; off-platform wins are not covered.

Likes and comments are captured from gallery cards to keep a consistent source. They may include engagement from earlier events. Listed team size comes from the public team section, with gallery member counts as a fallback. Past wins do not imply a win in this competition.

Additional metrics & export

Explore solo-team share, median likes, top-10% share of likes, store/distribution links, public source links, screenshot counts, story length, technologies, narrative themes, and category benchmarks. All percentages show or specify their denominator. Export respects active filters and includes source URLs and evidence fields. Unknown values are blank in CSV and null in JSON.

Presentation coverage is descriptive; more words or media do not establish a better app. Narrative mentions do not verify technical features.
